d: Belvedere next to a garden in the middle of which there is a plane tree. Served under the plane tree.
Arsamene, Elviro asleep, and Romilda in the belvedere.
Xerxes, Romilda; Arsamene and Elviro hidden.
Xerxes and Romilda still, and thoughtful.
Courtyard... amateurs in a man's dress followed by a Scout.
Ariodate, followed by Soldiers with Prisoners and signs taken to enemies, and Amastre.
Xerxes, Ariodate, and Amastre on the side.
Xerxes and Amastre with his Scout aside.
Square of the city. Amastre, and then Elviro selling flowers, and speaking the lingua franca.
Xerxes, and Atalanta, who reads the sheet of Arsamene.
Amazres in the process of killing themselves, and Elviro.
Bridge built above the sea, which joins two banks. Serse, Ariodate, and choir of Marinari.
Place of withdrawal, adjacent to the city. Xerxes on one side, Amastre on the other.
Xerxes, Romilda, and Amastre in part.
Gallery. Arsamene, Ruilda, and Elviro holding Arsamene.
Romilda, Arsamene, Elviro, and then Xerse.
Ruilda disdained that then meets in Xerxes.
Romilda, and Amastre with a letter in their hand.
Great temple, with the simulacrum of the sun, and burning plow. choir of ministers around the simulacrum.
